title: Word 11 — On the Fearful Judgment of Christ
attribution_note: Word 11 of 28 in the collection Short Moral-Instructive Words — see Word 1 for provenance.

pairs.en: Poor sinners! What do you think, hearing these words? God Himself is coming to judge you and to render to you according to your deeds. Be struck with horror at sinning and living lawlessly. God Himself is coming to judge you, coming with power and great glory. Spare us, O Lord, spare Your creation, for no one is without sin but You alone. Fearful, beloved, is that day and hour in which God will judge sinners. The judgment of men is fearful to us — but the judgment of God is incomparably more fearful.
At the judgment of men, only evil deeds are judged — at that judgment, *“for every idle word men shall give account”* [Matthew 12:36].

If even for an idle word there must be an answer, then on what do they hope — those who defile their soul and body with impurity; those who wring tears from widows and orphans; those who steal and carry off what belongs to others; those who cut and kill their neighbor with the tongue as with a sword; those who deal craftily and deceive people; and what do other lawless men hope for, who feed on wickedness as on bread? *“Behold, I come quickly, and My reward is with Me, to give to every man according as his work shall be.”*

In the first coming, the world saw Him suffering and dying for our sins; in the second, it will see Him sitting on the throne of His glory, judging sinners for their sins, and rendering to each according to his deeds.

Now He calls sinners to Himself: *“Come unto Me”* — but then He will say to the impenitent: *“Depart from Me”* [Matthew 25:34, 41]. To where? *“Into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.”*

Let us, then, repent, that we may receive mercy from Him, and be made worthy to stand at His right hand at His coming, and to hear from Him that most gracious voice: *“Come, ye blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world”* [Matthew 25:34]. Amen.
